_notes.summary: Per-member campaign milestones. Persist for the full campaign — not reset per beat. Completing a milestone grants flat prestige tracked separately from beat prestige.
_notes.availability: Universal milestones apply to every enlisted member. Chapter-affinity milestones apply when the member's chapter has tag_weight >= 1 for that tag. A member may have up to 13 active chapter-affinity milestone sets.
_notes.tracking: All milestones are auto-tracked and auto-awarded. No screenshots, no co-confirms, no self-reports required. The bot derives all counts from AAR records and campaign_log entries.

data_sources.aar_record: Parsed AAR fields: mission name, difficulty_class, gene_seed_carrier_id, armory_data, brother_ids, killed_in_action. Member must be in brother_ids to have an AAR count toward their milestone.
data_sources.aar_mission_lookup: Bot maps AAR mission name to operations.json to get: planet, terminus_boss (null if roaming-only), terminus_roaming list.
data_sources.campaign_log: campaign_log entry submitted by this member: terminus_killed (bool), strats_active[]. Bot matches entry to the member's AAR via aar_ref or timestamp proximity.
data_sources.beat_window: Bot infers which beat an AAR belongs to by comparing the AAR timestamp to campaign_state beat date windows. Used for all same-beat cross-checks.

_notes.completion: Once threshold is reached the bot posts an announcement and adds prestige_reward to the member's campaign prestige total. Non-repeatable — milestone locks once completed.
_notes.milestone_ids: Universal: u_01 through u_08. Chapter-affinity prefixed by tag abbreviation: term_01, agg_01, etc.

universal.label: Geneseed Bearer
universal.description: Carry geneseed to extraction in qualifying ops.

universal.label: Armory Adept
universal.description: Recover armory data in qualifying ops.

universal.label: Terminus Witness
universal.description: Participate in ops where a terminus target (roaming or fixed boss) was killed.
universal.tracking_rule: campaign_log entry submitted by member where terminus_killed == true

universal.label: Apex Slayer
universal.description: Participate in ops where a fixed-boss terminus was killed. Fixed-boss missions: Termination (Hierophant Bio-Titan), Exfiltration (Trygon), Vortex (Mutalith Vortex Beast), Reclamation (Tyranid Prime).
universal.tracking_rule: operations[mission].terminus_boss != null AND campaign_log entry by member where terminus_killed == true

universal.label: Campaign Veteran
universal.description: Complete qualifying ops across the campaign window.
universal.tracking_rule: member_id in brother_ids, AAR timestamp within campaign window

universal.label: Mission Specialist
universal.description: Complete 5 runs of the same mission. Bot awards for the first mission to hit the threshold.
universal.tracking_rule: count per distinct mission name where member_id in brother_ids; award when any single mission count >= 5

universal.label: Omega Operator
universal.description: Complete qualifying ops at omega_strats difficulty.
universal.tracking_rule: difficulty_class == omega_ops AND member_id in brother_ids

universal.label: Mission Breadth
universal.description: Complete 5 distinct mission types across the campaign.
universal.tracking_rule: count distinct mission names where member_id in brother_ids
